actual_scope: Complete next-pivot Schur transitions and full two-guard header counts for every ordered rank-two idempotent pair on F2^4, including 23 parent rows beyond the seven inherited source-specific rows; sharp minimum positive success probability 1/140.

bottleneck_link: State-aware shared-header recursion needs ordered successor distributions, not just parent classifications or first-pivot probabilities. stop_rule: Stop at the first independently checked complete table. No larger dimension, field, search or supplier expansion.
